mentions.name: Spreadsheet Divergence & Version Control Tool
mentions.description: This tool simplifies administrative work across fleets of similarly structured spreadsheets: it shows where spreadsheets diverge, propagates updates, makes them version controlled, and brings other app-development-style benefits to spreadsheet management without forcing users off spreadsheets.
mentions.problem: Companies often maintain 10+ spreadsheets with the same structure but different data (e.g., one per country for budgeting or modeling); they tend to break and are hard to update centrally, while moving to a proper admin app requires development and often delivers worse UX because users are familiar with spreadsheets.
mentions.audience: Companies and business users who manage many similarly structured spreadsheets (e.g., one per country for budgeting, modeling, or inputs), who prefer spreadsheets over custom admin apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: This is why I’m writing a tool to simplify administrative work with these files, so you can quickly see where spreadsheets diverge, propagate updates, make them version controlled, and many other good things, which we have in typical app development, but still miss in spreadsheets management.

evidence.value: This is why I’m writing a tool to simplify administrative work with these files, so you can quickly see where spreadsheets diverge, propagate updates, make them version controlled, and many other good things, which we have in typical app development, but still miss in spreadsheets management.
